tips.text: Hit enemies with Piercing Darkness between your attacks; each attack shortens its cooldown, and it slows enemies so you can keep poking.
Fire Piercing Darkness through an ally or enemy to heal your teammate. It also hits whatever is in the line behind them.
Aim Last Embrace at an enemy and keep it for when they close in. It hits the first enemy in its path, then roots them and anyone nearby after a short delay.
Collect the souls left by dying minions and champions with Absolution. Each one makes you hit harder and reach farther.
Use Curse of the Black Mist to walk up on enemies unseen, or to escape when a fight goes wrong. Allies who step into the mist get hidden too.
Use Dawning Shadow from anywhere on the map to finish off a fleeing enemy or to shield allies in a fight far from you.
Stay at the edge of your long attack range and chip at enemies. Their marked health drops with every second hit, so keep attacking the same target.

combos.name: Q through minion
combos.when: Trading in lane when an enemy stands behind a minion or an ally.
combos.text: Target a minion or an ally and the shot still pierces on to the enemy behind. This lets you slow and poke them, or heal an ally, in a single cast.

tips.text: Aim Last Embrace at the enemy you most want to catch; it roots them after a short delay, so cast it when they are walking toward you or stuck in place.
Use Piercing Darkness on an ally to heal them and on an enemy to hurt and slow them. It can hit a target behind your first one.
Auto-attack between spells; each attack shortens the cooldown of Piercing Darkness, so you can use it more often.
Attack the souls that appear when units die near you. Each one frees Mist, which makes your attacks hit harder and reach farther.
Hit enemy champions twice in a row with attacks or spells to trigger Absolution's bonus damage and gain Mist.
Use Curse of the Black Mist to approach or leave a fight unseen. Allies who walk into the cloud also become hidden.
Fire Dawning Shadow from anywhere on the map to shield allies in a fight you are not in, or to hit enemies who are lined up.
Hit enemy champions with Dawning Shadow when they are lined up in a fight. It passes through everyone in its path.

combos.name: Q through minion
combos.when: When an enemy is behind a minion or an ally and you want to poke from past your normal range.
combos.text: Piercing Darkness pierces through whatever it targets. Aim it at a minion or ally so the beam also hits the enemy champion behind it.

tips.text: Poke Ashe with Piercing Darkness when she goes for a last-hit; it hits through minions and slows her.
Land Last Embrace on Ashe, then punish her while she is rooted; she has few ways to escape.
Stay away from the line of Volley, and keep minions between you and Ashe so they absorb the arrows.
Watch for Enchanted Crystal Arrow before roaming alone; when it is on cooldown, you are much safer.

comboRefs.note: Piercing Q through a minion pokes Ashe, who has no listed ability that blocks or stops it.

tips.text: Hit Caitlyn with Piercing Darkness through a minion to slow her, then step in and attack while she is slowed.
Land Last Embrace on Caitlyn when she is out of position. Her only quick escape is her net, which needs time to cast.
Walk around Yordle Snap Trap. If you are rooted by it, Caitlyn gets a long-range Headshot on you.
Stay behind minions when Piltover Peacemaker is coming, because it does less damage to each target after the first.
Collect the Mist Wraiths after kills. Each one extends your range, so you fall behind Caitlyn less over time.
Stand in the path of Ace in the Hole to block it when Caitlyn aims at your ally.

comboRefs.note: Q pierces through a minion to slow and poke Caitlyn, who outranges lane trades with her rifle.

tips.text: Aim Last Embrace at Ezreal when he has nowhere to go. If Arcane Shift is down, the root will set up your team's follow-up.
Stay behind minions. Mystic Shot hits the first enemy in its path, so a minion in front of you soaks it up.
Use Piercing Darkness on Ezreal to slow him, then hit him with attacks. He then struggles to line up shots or walk away.
Free the souls from Absolution when it is safe. The extra range lets you outpoke Ezreal.
Ezreal is fragile, so take the fight to him once his Arcane Shift is used.
Poke Jhin with Piercing Darkness; it slows him and its cooldown drops when you attack.
Jhin can't attack while reloading after his fourth shot. Jump on him with Last Embrace then.
Jhin's Deadly Flourish roots you only if you were recently damaged. Stay out of his line and avoid taking chip damage first.
Watch bushes and chokepoints for Jhin's hidden Captive Audience traps. Don't walk into them while chasing.
Use Curse of the Black Mist to approach unseen or to escape when Jhin lines up Curtain Call.

comboRefs.note: Piercing Darkness through a minion still reaches Jhin behind it, slowing him so he's easier to poke.

tips.text: Hit Jinx with Last Embrace when she steps forward to last-hit; the root keeps her in place for your follow-up.
Jinx's Flame Chompers! are her main escape, so go in on her when she wastes them.
Use Piercing Darkness to hit Jinx from range; it slows her and shoots through the minions in front.
Jump on Jinx while she is poking with rockets, before her minigun ramps up.
Stay out of Zap! range or step behind minions; it hits the first enemy and slows you.
Use Last Embrace on Kai'Sa when she steps up to trade. The root holds her still for your Piercing Darkness and attacks.
Out-range Kai'Sa and poke her with attacks and Piercing Darkness. She has to walk into your range to trade.
Stay near your ADC. Killer Instinct lets Kai'Sa jump onto anyone with Plasma, so don't stand alone once she has hit you.
Hit Kai'Sa with Dawning Shadow when she dashes in with Killer Instinct. The shield on your ally can save them from her burst.

comboRefs.note: Piercing Darkness through a minion slows and pokes Kai'Sa, making it harder for her to stack Plasma.

tips.text: Poke Miss Fortune with Piercing Darkness; it slows her, and the hit stops her Strut speed bonus.
Land Last Embrace on Miss Fortune, then punish her while she is rooted. She is easy to kill if you reach her.
Do not stand directly behind a minion in front of you; Double Up bounces through it onto you.
Leave Make It Rain's area quickly; its slow cannot be cleansed.
Use your longer range to hit Miss Fortune first and fall back, and build up Mist by freeing souls.
Break line of sight or use Curse of the Black Mist when Miss Fortune starts Bullet Time; the channel is long and you can step away.

comboRefs.note: Piercing Darkness passes through a minion to slow and poke Miss Fortune behind it.

tips.text: Smolder is weak early. Poke him with Piercing Darkness whenever he steps up to last-hit, and push your lead before he stacks up.
Land Last Embrace on Smolder when he flies in or tries to leave; he is rooted and cannot escape.
Hold your Last Embrace for when Smolder uses Flap, Flap, Flap; being rooted ends his flight early.
Stay out of a straight line with Smolder's Achooo!; it slows you, and the explosion hurts you and your support if you stand together.
Use your long attack range to hit Smolder from outside his reach, especially once Mist has built up.
Hit Yunara with Last Embrace when she steps forward to last-hit; the delayed root gives you free Piercing Darkness and basic attacks.
Fire Last Embrace in a straight line; it stops at the first enemy hit, so a minion in the way takes it instead of Yunara.
Your Senna has longer range than Yunara early, so poke her with basic attacks and Piercing Darkness while she walks up to farm.
Save Last Embrace for when Yunara commits forward or dashes in; she has few ways to escape once rooted.
Back off when Yunara uses Transcend One's Self; she hits harder and can dash away. Wait for it to end before you trade.

comboRefs.note: Q pierces through a minion to slow and poke Yunara, who has no listed way to block the shot.

tips.text: Keep your distance from Alistar and save Last Embrace to root him as he comes in, then back away.
Slow Alistar with Piercing Darkness as he walks up; the slow helps you stay out of his Headbutt and Pulverize.
Do not stand near turrets or in front of your allies when Alistar is up; Headbutt then Pulverize can catch you.
Do not waste damage on Alistar while Unbreakable Will is active; back off until it ends.
Poke Anivia with Piercing Darkness through minions. Her Flash Frost is slow, so keep out of its line.
Sidestep Flash Frost. Being stunned at its end leaves you open to Frostbite.
Use Last Embrace on Anivia when she commits, then kill her. Gank her too, so her egg dies.
Do not stand inside Glacial Storm. Hit Anivia when she is low on mana, since the storm drains it fast.
Poke with Piercing Darkness from long range; it slows Bard, and every attack you land shortens its cooldown.
Land Last Embrace on Bard when he steps up; the delay is short, so aim at where he is heading. If it connects, he is rooted for a moment and you can punish him.
Stay out of line with your lane partner, because Cosmic Binding stuns two enemies in a row or one that is against a wall.
Step on Bard's healing shrines to destroy them, and do not let his partner take them.
Use Dawning Shadow to hit Bard and his partner when they are stuck in a fight; the beam keeps going after the first hit.

comboRefs.note: Piercing Darkness pokes through a minion to hit Bard, who can't easily answer it from range.

tips.text: Stay behind minions so Rocket Grab hits them first. Step out of line when Blitzcrank has it ready.
Hit Blitzcrank with Last Embrace when he walks up; it roots him and anyone near him, so he cannot follow up.
Do not stand near Blitzcrank at level 6 after a grab. Static Field silences you and removes your shields.
Use your long range and Piercing Darkness to slow and hit Blitzcrank from afar, keeping out of his Power Fist reach.
Dodge Brand's first spell, Sear or Pillar of Flame. Without an ablaze target he cannot start his combo.
Use your long attack range to poke Brand and stay out of his Conflagration range.
Hit Brand with Last Embrace when he commits to a spell, so he is rooted and cannot dodge the follow-up.
Stand apart from your ally when Brand casts Pyroclasm, since it bounces between nearby enemies.
Slow Brand with Piercing Darkness when he steps forward, then walk out of his range.
Stay out of Braum's Winter's Bite line, since minions in front of you block it. Stand behind them when you can.
Don't throw Last Embrace into a raised Unbreakable; it is destroyed. Wait for the shield to drop or come from another angle.
Use Piercing Darkness on Braum from range; his shield can't stop it, and it slows him.
Step away once Braum or his partner has marked you; a few more hits will stun you.
Walk out of the path of Glacial Fissure when you see Braum begin it, and avoid walking on the ice afterward.
Keep Last Embrace ready for when Camille dives in. It roots her and anyone near her.
Poke Camille with Piercing Darkness while she approaches. It slows her and your attacks shorten its cooldown.
Stay away from walls, because Hookshot needs terrain to latch onto. Hold your position and do not let her reach you.
Use Curse of the Black Mist to hide your position from Camille and set up your own plays.
Poke Janna with Piercing Darkness through minions; it hits everything in its line and slows her.
Janna's Howling Gale knocks up, so stay out of her line when she charges it. Listen for the charge sound.
Aim Last Embrace at Janna when she has used Zephyr; the root keeps her from escaping and Monsoon cannot save her once she is stuck.
Janna's Monsoon is her big defensive tool. Hit her with Dawning Shadow or root her before it comes, since moving or casting ends it early.
Harass Janna's partner; she is strongest when shielding an ally, so a hurt carry weakens her.

comboRefs.note: Piercing Darkness through a minion pokes Janna from past normal range and slows her.

tips.text: Stay out of Karma's Inner Flame line. Keep a minion between you; it stops at the first unit it hits.
Use your long range to stay behind minions and attack Karma. Her tether only reaches so far, so keep distance.
Move away when Focused Resolve tethers you. Break the tether and you won't be rooted.
Hit Karma with Last Embrace when she steps up to cast; the root keeps her in place for your team to follow up.
Use Piercing Darkness through a minion to hit Karma while you heal your partner and slow her.
Poke Leona with Piercing Darkness from long range. Don't let her get close, because she has no way to stop her engage.
Save Last Embrace for when Leona dashes in with Zenith Blade. Rooting her away from your carry stops her engage.
Stay behind minions. Zenith Blade needs to hit a champion to dash, and minions in the way can block your view of the angle.
Don't fight Leona while Eclipse is up; her armor and magic resist are high. Wait for it to end and then trade.
Dodge Solar Flare by leaving its center when it appears; only the center stuns.
Aim Last Embrace at Lulu when she walks up to poke; the root gives you time to trade freely.
Stay behind minions when Lulu attacks; Pix's bolts are stopped by the first unit they hit.
Dodge Glitterlance by sidestepping its line; it is slow-moving enough to read, and getting slowed makes you easy to catch.
Keep your distance from Lulu's ally at level 6; Wild Growth knocks you up and slows you around the enlarged champion.
Don't stand next to a Lulu-enhanced ally who may Whimsy you; use Piercing Darkness from a long way back instead.
Poke with Piercing Darkness from long range; each attack you make lowers its cooldown, so mix in auto attacks.
Sidestep Light Binding; it roots the first two enemies it hits, so do not stand lined up with your carry.
Land Last Embrace on Lux when she commits; the root arrives after a short delay, so cast it where she is heading.
Move to the side when you see Final Spark's red warning beam.
Use Curse of the Black Mist to slip away or reposition; you become camouflaged and move faster.

comboRefs.note: Piercing Darkness through a minion pokes Lux from beyond range before she can poke or root.

tips.text: Stay at long range and poke Maokai rather than trading in his reach. Every spell you waste on him shortens his passive cooldown.
Don't use Last Embrace or Piercing Darkness on Maokai while he is dashing with Twisted Advance; he can't be targeted.
Stay away from brush and from Saplings chasing you. They slow you and hurt more in brush.
Don't stand close to Maokai when Bramble Smash is ready; it knocks you back and stuns you.
Hold Last Embrace until Mel has used Rebuttal; it destroys projectiles, so your root never lands if you throw it first.
Poke with Piercing Darkness from long range. It never misses and slows Mel, and each of your attacks shortens its cooldown.
Stay out of Solar Snare's line, especially from far away, since a long-range hit roots you longer. Step aside or hide behind a minion.
Back off when Mel's Overwhelm stacks build on you. If you are low, her next hit can kill you, so let the stacks fall off.
Mel's attack right after an ability hits harder because of Searing Brilliance. Do not trade attacks with her just after she casts.
Hit Milio with Last Embrace when he stands in front of his carry; the root gives your lane time to jump on him.
Stay out of line with Milio's Ultra Mega Fire Kick, since it stuns the first enemy it hits. Step behind a minion so it stops there.
Use Piercing Darkness through a minion to hit Milio from long range. It slows him and gives you a free poke.
Catch Milio alone with Last Embrace. His allies can't save him if he is rooted.
Save Dawning Shadow for when Milio's team is grouped up. Breath of Life will cleanse their crowd control, so lock down enemies after he has spent it.

comboRefs.note: Piercing Darkness through a minion pokes Milio, who has no listed way to block or dodge it.

tips.text: Stand behind minions so Dark Binding hits them first; it stops at the first enemy it touches.
Hit Morgana with Last Embrace when she is out of position; it does damage and then roots her and anyone near her.
Poke Morgana with attacks and Piercing Darkness from long range; her Black Shield cannot block physical damage.
Do not stand near Morgana at level 6 once Soul Shackles is on you; walk out of its range before it ends or you get stunned.
Stay away from Tormented Shadow when you are low on health; it hurts more the lower you are.
Stay out of line of Aqua Prison; the bubble takes a moment to land, so keep moving sideways when Nami aims at you.
Punish Nami right after she misses Aqua Prison; her cooldown is long, so that is your window to trade.
Use your long attack range to poke Nami from afar and step back when an ally is empowered by Tidecaller's Blessing.
Hit Nami with Last Embrace when she steps up to cast; she is rooted and open to your damage and your carry's.
Use Piercing Darkness to slow Nami when she engages or retreats, and to heal your carry through a trade.
Sidestep Tidal Wave when you see it coming; it travels slowly.
Stay behind your minions and keep your distance from Nautilus. Dredge Line stops at the first enemy it hits, so minions can shield you.
Use Piercing Darkness to slow Nautilus as he approaches and to poke him from long range.
Land Last Embrace on Nautilus when he walks up. It roots him and anyone near him, so he can't follow or engage.
Use Curse of the Black Mist to hide in a bush or reposition. Nautilus then can't see where to aim Dredge Line.
When Nautilus shields himself with Titan's Wrath, avoid his auto attacks and don't stand next to your carry.

comboRefs.note: Piercing Darkness through a minion pokes Nautilus from range, so he struggles to close in.

tips.text: Hit Neeko with Last Embrace when she steps up; the root lands after a short delay, so follow with attacks while she is stuck.
Use Piercing Darkness from long range to slow and poke Neeko; she has no way to close in unless she lands Tangle-Barbs.
Stay out of a straight line with Neeko and keep minions from standing between you, since Tangle-Barbs grows stronger after hitting something.
Before Neeko's level 6, hold Curse of the Black Mist for an escape or a flank, and watch out for her disguise.
Respect Pop Blossom at level 6. Stay back from Neeko when she is disguised, because her warning is hidden.

comboRefs.note: Piercing Darkness through a minion pokes Neeko, who has no listed way to block the beam.

tips.text: Keep Pantheon at range with Piercing Darkness; it slows him and every hit you land makes it ready sooner.
Save Last Embrace for when Pantheon jumps in; rooting him lets you and your partner punish him.
Do not attack Pantheon head-on while Aegis Assault is up; step to the side or wait for it to end.
Do not sit low on health near Pantheon; a thrown Comet Spear hurts weak targets a lot more.
When Grand Starfall is announced, move out of the target area; it gives time to react.
Stay behind minions or your partner when you are in range of Shield Vault; the stun leaves you open.
Root Poppy with Last Embrace when she charges at you, then back away.
Stay away from walls when Poppy is close; Heroic Charge into terrain stuns you.
Do not dash near Poppy while Steadfast Presence is up; it stops you and knocks you up.
Step on Poppy's buckler to destroy it and deny her shield.
Hit Poppy with Piercing Darkness from range to slow her and keep her from reaching you.
Move away when you see Poppy start to spin her hammer; that is Keeper's Verdict charging.
Hit Last Embrace on Pyke when he comes close; it roots him in place, so you can follow up with your cannon and Piercing Darkness.
Stay out of Pyke's hook range; your long attack range lets you poke him while he waits to line up Bone Skewer.
Keep Last Embrace ready for when Pyke dives in with Phantom Undertow; rooting him cuts off his chase.
Use Curse of the Black Mist to hide your team from Pyke's view and set up a surprise engage.
Stay away from low-health allies when Pyke is near; Death From Below can execute them. Heal them with Piercing Darkness.
Throw Last Embrace at Rakan when he is away from his ally; it hits the first enemy and roots him and anyone near him, so follow up with an attack.
Use Piercing Darkness to poke Rakan from long range. It slows him, and each attack you land shortens its cooldown.
Stay behind your minions and keep your range. Rakan wants to land Grand Entrance on you, and your long attack range lets you stay out of it.
Rakan's dashes show where he will land. Aim Last Embrace at that spot when he commits.
When Rakan's Fey Feathers shield is up, wait to trade until it breaks.

comboRefs.note: Piercing Darkness through a minion lets Senna poke Rakan from range when he stands behind it.

tips.text: Stay outside Rell's reach. Shattering Strike and Ferromancy: Crash Down both need her close, so use your long attack range to poke her instead.
Hit Rell with Last Embrace when she charges in. She is rooted and can't follow up on you.
Use Piercing Darkness to slow Rell when she closes in, then back away so she can't land her stun.
Be careful when Rell's Magnet Storm is ready at level 6. It pulls you in, so keep your distance from her in fights.
Rell's Shattering Strike destroys shields, so don't count on Dawning Shadow's shield for a fight when she is close.

comboRefs.note: Piercing Darkness pokes through a minion to hit Rell from beyond her reach before she can engage.

tips.text: Poke Seraphine with your long-range attacks. Piercing Darkness also slows her and shortens its own cooldown with every attack.
Sidestep Beat Drop; it is a narrow line. Getting slowed first makes it root you, so avoid being slowed near Seraphine.
Hit Seraphine with Last Embrace when she steps up to poke. The root after the delay lets your carry finish her.
Stay spread out from your team near Seraphine's ultimate. Encore extends through every champion it hits, and the charm lets Beat Drop stun you.
Use Curse of the Black Mist to get away from Seraphine or to approach her unseen for a surprise Last Embrace.
Keep range on Shen and poke him with your long-range basic attacks; he has to dash in to reach you.
Hold Last Embrace for when Shen dashes in; rooted, he can't follow up on his taunt.
Stay out of line of Shadow Dash; being taunted means you can't get away from his team.
Shen's Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks, so don't auto into it; use Piercing Darkness or wait for it to end.
Use Last Embrace on Sona when she walks up for a cast. It roots her so your team can punish her.
Attack from your long range and use Piercing Darkness to slow Sona. She is fragile and has to come close to trade.
Stay spread out from your partner, and watch Sona at level 6. Crescendo has long range and stuns everything it hits.
Go for Sona first in a fight; she heals her team with Aria of Perseverance if left alone.
Hit Soraka with Last Embrace when she walks up to use Starcall; the root holds her in place for your damage.
Out-range Soraka with your attacks, and use Piercing Darkness to slow her and heal your carry.
Stay out of Equinox. When it ends it roots you, so walk out of the field early.
Equinox has a long cooldown, so trade with Soraka right after she uses it.
Hit Soraka first, not her carry; she is easier to kill than the ally she heals.
Hit Swain with Last Embrace when he walks up. If it lands, the root gives you time to attack and back away.
Use your long range to attack Swain from afar. Stay out of Nevermove range, because getting rooted lets him pull you in.
Keep moving when Vision of Empire appears under you. Walk out of the circle before it blows up to avoid the slow.
Use Piercing Darkness to slow Swain and keep him from reaching you, or to heal yourself and your ally.
Do not stay near Swain once he starts Demonic Ascension. Back away, since he is easy to get away from.

comboRefs.note: Piercing Darkness through a minion pokes Swain from range, which helps vs his Soul Fragment healing.

tips.text: Poke Tahm Kench from long range with your attacks and Piercing Darkness. Keep your distance so he can't reach you with Tongue Lash.
Stay back from Tahm Kench, because Tongue Lash is his main way to catch you. Keep minions between you and him when you can.
Hit Tahm Kench with Last Embrace when he dives in or channels Abyssal Dive. Being rooted cancels his channel.
Avoid being hit three times by Tahm Kench's attacks and Tongue Lash. At three stacks he can Devour you, so back off after the second hit.
Keep your range advantage and attack Taric from afar. Don't let him walk up and chain Bravado attacks on you.
Dodge Dazzle by moving out of the beam during its delay. It bursts after a short wait, so don't stand still.
Use Piercing Darkness on Taric when he approaches; it slows him and damages him. Your attacks shorten its cooldown.
Hit Taric with Last Embrace when he commits to a trade; he is rooted and can't follow up or escape.
When Taric casts Cosmic Radiance, back off or burst someone down before it finishes. Don't waste Dawning Shadow into invulnerable targets.
Stay out of Death Sentence range and watch for his cast to begin. Sidestep it, because the scythe is blocked by the first unit it hits.
Hit Thresh with Last Embrace when he commits to a pull or dash; the enemies near him are rooted too, so you can follow up.
Poke Thresh with Piercing Darkness from long range. It slows him, so he struggles to close the gap.
Use your long attack range to hit Thresh when he steps up to collect souls. He is exposed then.
Save Curse of the Black Mist for scouting or sneaking close to an engage. It is not a reliable dodge against his pull.
Hit Vel'Koz with Last Embrace when he stands back to poke. He has little mobility, so the root keeps him in your reach.
Vel'Koz is easy to catch when his Tectonic Disruption is on cooldown. Walk up and fight him then.
Use Curse of the Black Mist to disappear and move around his Void Rift pokes. Use it to flank him.
Piercing Darkness slows Vel'Koz and can hit him through minions. Use it to close in while his shots miss.
Dodge the Plasma Fission bolt by staying off the line of minions and watch for its split. Avoid standing near its edges.

comboRefs.note: Piercing Darkness through a minion or ally lets Senna poke Vel'Koz from beyond her normal range.

tips.text: Stay out of a straight line from Xerath, and sidestep Shocking Orb. A long stun leaves you open to Eye of Destruction.
Close the distance on Xerath and trade. Last Embrace roots him and leaves him stuck for your follow-up attacks.
Use Piercing Darkness on Xerath when he charges Arcanopulse. He is slowed while charging, so he can't easily get away.
Use Curse of the Black Mist to dodge his spells. Senna can't be selected while in the mist, so you can walk up to him.
Hit Yuumi with Last Embrace while she is alone; she is untargetable once attached, so catch her before she latches on.
Fire Piercing Darkness through minions at Yuumi when she is detached; it passes through units and slows her.
Use Dawning Shadow to hit Yuumi or her partner from far away; it has global range and keeps going after a hit.
Go for Last Embrace on the carry when Yuumi is attached; the root holds them still while you trade.
Keep your attack range advantage and poke when Yuumi's Prowling Projectile is on cooldown, since it is her main way to hurt you.
Zilean's stun needs two Time Bombs. When one sticks to you, walk away from his second so the first doesn't blow early.
Zilean is hard to kill alone, so use Last Embrace to root him and then trade with your team. Fight him with your ally close by.
Keep poking Zilean from long range with Piercing Darkness. It slows him and heals your ally, and attacks lower its cooldown.
Chronoshift makes an ally revive. Pause before the killing blow until it fades, then finish with Dawning Shadow or an attack.
Sidestep Grasping Roots; it is slow-moving and narrow, and being rooted next to Zyra's plants hurts.
Use your long attack range to poke Zyra, and shoot her plants from out of their reach.
Step on Zyra's seeds before she grows them, or avoid them, so she has fewer plants to use.
Use Last Embrace on Zyra when she steps up to cast; the root lets your team punish her.
Spread out from your partner at level 6 so one Stranglethorns does not knock up you both.

comboRefs.note: Piercing Darkness through a minion pokes Zyra from long range, keeping Senna away from Zyra's roots.
